## Lasso Regression (Benchmarking dan Validasi)

```{r Setup}
library(tidymodels)
library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(123)
```

```{r Load Data dan Cek Multikolinearitas}
data <- read.csv(file.choose(),header=T,sep=";",dec=",")
head(data)
summary(data)
colSums(is.na(data))

library(car)
model <- lm(Y1 ~ X1 + X2 + X3 + X4 + X5 + X6 + X7 + X8, data = data)
alias(model)

if (any(is.na(coef(model)))) {
  cat("VIF tidak bisa dihitung karena ada korelasi sempurna (Aliased coefficients).\n")
  cat("Terdapat variabel yang redundan 100% secara matematis.\n")
} else {
  # Jika aman, hitung dan tampilkan VIF
  nilai_vif <- vif(model)
  print(sort(nilai_vif, decreasing = TRUE))
}

```

```{r Split dan Cross Validation}
data_y1 <- data%>%select(-Y2)
data_y2 <- data%>%select(-Y1)
head(data_y2)

split_HL <- initial_split(data_y1, prop = 0.8, strata = Y1)
train_HL<- training(split_HL)
test_HL <- testing(split_HL)

split_CL <- initial_split(data_y2, prop = 0.8, strata = Y2)
train_CL<- training(split_CL)
test_CL <- testing(split_CL)

cv_HL <- vfold_cv(train_HL, v = 5)
cv_CL <- vfold_cv(train_CL, v = 5)

```

```{r Recip, Lasso Regression, dan Tuning}
rec_HL <- recipe(Y1~., data = train_HL) %>% step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
rec_CL <- recipe(Y2~., data = train_CL) %>% step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

lasso_spec <- linear_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = 1) %>%
  set_engine("glmnet") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

wf_HL <- workflow() %>%add_recipe(rec_HL) %>% add_model(lasso_spec)
wf_CL <- workflow() %>%add_recipe(rec_CL) %>% add_model(lasso_spec)

penalty_grid <- grid_regular(penalty(range = c(-4, 1)), levels = 50)

tune_HL<- tune_grid(wf_HL, resamples =cv_HL, grid = penalty_grid, metrics = metric_set(rmse,rsq))
tune_CL<- tune_grid(wf_CL, resamples =cv_CL, grid = penalty_grid, metrics = metric_set(rmse,rsq))

best_HL <- select_best(tune_HL, metric = "rmse")
best_HL
best_CL <- select_best(tune_CL, metric = "rmse")
best_CL

```

```{r Lasso Final}
finalwf_HL <- finalize_workflow(wf_HL, best_HL)
finalwf_CL <- finalize_workflow(wf_CL, best_CL)

finalfit_HL <- last_fit(finalwf_HL, split = split_HL)
finalfit_CL <- last_fit(finalwf_CL, split = split_CL)

finalHL_metrics <- collect_metrics(finalfit_HL)
finalHL_metrics
finalCL_metrics <- collect_metrics(finalfit_CL)
finalCL_metrics

model_HL <- extract_fit_parsnip(finalfit_HL)
tidy(model_HL) %>% 
  filter(estimate != 0) %>% 
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) %>% 
  print()
model_CL <- extract_fit_parsnip(finalfit_CL)
tidy(model_CL) %>% 
  filter(estimate != 0) %>% 
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) %>% 
  print()

```

```{r Ridge Regression}
ridge_spec <- linear_reg(penalty = tune(),mixture = 0) %>%
  set_engine("glmnet") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

wfHL_ridge <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(rec_HL) %>% add_model(ridge_spec)
wfCL_ridge <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(rec_CL) %>% add_model(ridge_spec)

tuneHL_ridge <-tune_grid(wfHL_ridge, resamples = cv_HL, grid = penalty_grid, metrics = metric_set(rmse,rsq))
tuneCL_ridge <- tune_grid(wfCL_ridge, resamples = cv_CL, grid = penalty_grid, metrics = metric_set(rmse,rsq))

bestHL_ridge<- select_best(tuneHL_ridge, metric = "rmse")
bestCL_ridge<- select_best(tuneCL_ridge, metric = "rmse")

finalwf_HL_ridge <- finalize_workflow(wfHL_ridge, bestHL_ridge)
finalwf_CL_ridge <- finalize_workflow(wfCL_ridge, bestCL_ridge)

finalfit_HL_ridge <- last_fit(finalwf_HL_ridge, split = split_HL)
finalfit_CL_ridge <- last_fit(finalwf_CL_ridge, split = split_CL)

finalHL_Ridge_metrics <- collect_metrics(finalfit_HL_ridge)
finalHL_Ridge_metrics 
finalCL_Ridge_metrics <- collect_metrics(finalfit_CL_ridge)
finalCL_Ridge_metrics

HL_ridge <- extract_fit_parsnip(finalfit_HL_ridge)
tidy(HL_ridge) %>% 
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) %>% 
  print()
CL_ridge <- extract_fit_parsnip(finalfit_CL_ridge)
tidy(CL_ridge) %>% 
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) %>% 
  print()

```

```{r Linear Regression}
lm_spec <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

wfHL_lm <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(rec_HL) %>%
  add_model(lm_spec)
wfCL_lm <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(rec_CL) %>%
  add_model(lm_spec)

finalfit_HL_lm <- last_fit(
  wfHL_lm,
  split = split_HL
)

finalfit_CL_lm <- last_fit(
  wfCL_lm,
  split = split_CL
)

finalHL_LM_metrics <- collect_metrics(finalfit_HL_lm)
finalHL_LM_metrics
finalCL_LM_metrics <- collect_metrics(finalfit_CL_lm)
finalCL_LM_metrics

HL_lm <- extract_fit_parsnip(finalfit_HL_lm)
tidy(HL_lm) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) %>%
  print()
CL_lm <- extract_fit_parsnip(finalfit_CL_lm)
tidy(CL_lm) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) %>%
  print()

```

```{r Benchmarking Lasso, Ridge, dan Linear Regression}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

df_metrics_HL_lasso <- finalHL_metrics %>%
  mutate(Model = "Lasso",
         Target = "Heating Load (Y1)")
df_metrics_HL_ridge <- finalHL_Ridge_metrics %>%
  mutate(Model = "Ridge",
         Target = "Heating Load (Y1)")
df_metrics_HL_lm <- finalHL_LM_metrics %>%
  mutate(Model = "Linear Regression",
         Target = "Heating Load (Y1)")

df_metrics_CL_lasso <- finalCL_metrics %>%
  mutate(Model = "Lasso",
         Target = "Cooling Load (Y2)")
df_metrics_CL_ridge <- finalCL_Ridge_metrics %>%
  mutate(Model = "Ridge",
         Target = "Cooling Load (Y2)")
df_metrics_CL_lm <- finalCL_LM_metrics %>%
  mutate(Model = "Linear Regression",
         Target = "Cooling Load (Y2)")

df_metrics_all <- bind_rows(
  df_metrics_HL_lasso,
  df_metrics_HL_ridge,
  df_metrics_HL_lm,
  df_metrics_CL_lasso,
  df_metrics_CL_ridge,
  df_metrics_CL_lm
) %>%
  select(Target, Model, .metric, .estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = .metric,
    values_from = .estimate
  ) %>%
  rename(
    RMSE = rmse,
    R_Squared = rsq
  ) %>%
  arrange(Target, Model)

cat("\n--- RINGKASAN METRIK KINERJA KESELURUHAN ---\n")
print(df_metrics_all)

```

```{r Data Frame Koefisien (Heating Load - Y1)}
coef_HL_lasso <- tidy(model_HL) %>%
  select(term, estimate) %>%
  rename(Lasso_Coef = estimate)

coef_HL_ridge <- tidy(HL_ridge) %>%
  select(term, estimate) %>%
  rename(Ridge_Coef = estimate)

coef_HL_lm <- tidy(HL_lm) %>%
  select(term, estimate) %>%
  rename(Linear_Coef = estimate)

df_coef_HL <- full_join(
  coef_HL_lasso,
  coef_HL_ridge,
  by = "term"
) %>%
  full_join(
    coef_HL_lm,
    by = "term"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Lasso_Coef)))

cat("\n--- PERBANDINGAN KOEFISIEN (HEATING LOAD Y1) ---\n")
print(df_coef_HL)

```

```{r Data Frame Koefisien (Cooling Load - Y2)}
coef_CL_lasso <- tidy(model_CL) %>%
  select(term, estimate) %>%
  rename(Lasso_Coef = estimate)

coef_CL_ridge <- tidy(CL_ridge) %>%
  select(term, estimate) %>%
  rename(Ridge_Coef = estimate)

coef_CL_lm <- tidy(CL_lm) %>%
  select(term, estimate) %>%
  rename(Linear_Coef = estimate)

df_coef_CL <- full_join(
  coef_CL_lasso,
  coef_CL_ridge,
  by = "term"
) %>%
  full_join(
    coef_CL_lm,
    by = "term"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Lasso_Coef)))

cat("\n--- PERBANDINGAN KOEFISIEN (COOLING LOAD Y2) ---\n")
print(df_coef_CL)

```

```{r Identifikasi Variabel yang dibuang Lasso}
cat("\n--- VARIABEL Y1 DENGAN KOEFISIEN LASSO = 0 ---\n")
df_coef_HL %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lasso_Coef), Lasso_Coef == 0) %>%
  print()

cat("\n--- VARIABEL Y2 DENGAN KOEFISIEN LASSO = 0 ---\n")
df_coef_CL %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lasso_Coef), Lasso_Coef == 0) %>%
  print()
```

```{r Stabilitas Lasso Regression (Heating Load - Y1)}
ctrl_extract <- control_resamples(
  extract = function(x) {
    # Ambil modelnya, rapikan (tidy), dan kembalikan outputnya
    extract_fit_parsnip(x) %>% tidy()
  }
)

set.seed(123)
cv_stability <- fit_resamples(
  finalwf_HL,           # Workflow dengan penalti terbaik untuk Heating Load
  resamples = cv_HL,    # 5-fold CV yang sama dengan sebelumnya
  control = ctrl_extract
)

stability_results <- cv_stability %>%
  select(id, .extracts) %>%
  unnest(.extracts) %>%
  unnest(.extracts) %>%                     # Membongkar dua lapis list
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%         # Mengabaikan Intercept (karena selalu ada)
  mutate(is_selected = ifelse(estimate != 0, 1, 0)) %>% # Beri nilai 1 jika tidak dibuang (tidak 0)
  group_by(term) %>%                        # Kelompokkan berdasarkan nama fitur
  summarise(
    selection_frequency = sum(is_selected), # Berapa kali dipilih dari 5 fold?
    stability_percent = (selection_frequency / 5) * 100 # Persentase stabilitas
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(stability_percent))          # Urutkan dari yang paling stabil
print(stability_results)

```

```{r Stabilitas Lasso Regression (Cooling Load - Y2)}
set.seed(123)
cv_stabilityCL <- fit_resamples(
  finalwf_CL,           # Workflow dengan penalti terbaik untuk Cooling Load
  resamples = cv_CL,    # 5-fold CV yang sama dengan sebelumnya
  control = ctrl_extract
)

stability_resultsCL <- cv_stabilityCL %>%
  select(id, .extracts) %>%
  unnest(.extracts) %>%
  unnest(.extracts) %>%                     # Membongkar dua lapis list
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%         # Mengabaikan Intercept (karena selalu ada)
  mutate(is_selected = ifelse(estimate != 0, 1, 0)) %>% # Beri nilai 1 jika tidak dibuang (tidak 0)
  group_by(term) %>%                        # Kelompokkan berdasarkan nama fitur
  summarise(
    selection_frequency = sum(is_selected), # Berapa kali dipilih dari 5 fold?
    stability_percent = (selection_frequency / 5) * 100 # Persentase stabilitas
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(stability_percent))          # Urutkan dari yang paling stabil
print(stability_resultsCL)

```

```{r Diagnostik Lasso Regression}
library(ggplot2)
# 1. PREDIKSI HEATING LOAD
pred_HL <- collect_predictions(finalfit_HL)
pred_HL <- pred_HL %>%
  mutate(
    residual = Y1 - .pred,
    abs_residual = abs(residual)
  )

# 2. PREDIKSI COOLING LOAD
pred_CL <- collect_predictions(finalfit_CL)
pred_CL <- pred_CL %>%
  mutate(
    residual = Y2 - .pred,
    abs_residual = abs(residual)
  )

# 3. ACTUAL VS PREDICTED
ggplot(pred_HL, aes(x = Y1, y = .pred)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Actual vs Predicted - Heating Load",
    x = "Actual",
    y = "Predicted"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(pred_CL, aes(x = Y2, y = .pred)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Actual vs Predicted - Cooling Load",
    x = "Actual",
    y = "Predicted"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# 4. RESIDUAL VS PREDICTED
ggplot(pred_HL, aes(x = .pred, y = residual)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Residual vs Predicted - Heating Load",
    x = "Predicted",
    y = "Residual"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(pred_CL, aes(x = .pred, y = residual)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Residual vs Predicted - Cooling Load",
    x = "Predicted",
    y = "Residual"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# 5. DISTRIBUSI RESIDUAL
ggplot(pred_HL, aes(x = residual)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribusi Residual - Heating Load",
    x = "Residual",
    y = "Frekuensi"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(pred_CL, aes(x = residual)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribusi Residual - Cooling Load",
    x = "Residual",
    y = "Frekuensi"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
# 6. TOP 10 ERROR
failure_HL <- pred_HL %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_residual))

failure_CL <- pred_CL %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_residual))
# Tampilkan Top 10
failure_HL %>%
  select(Y1, .pred, residual, abs_residual) %>%
  head(10)

failure_CL %>%
  select(Y2, .pred, residual, abs_residual) %>%
  head(10)

```
